title: Kibrit Çöpü Mezarlığı
author: Büşra Yılmaz
description: In the second book, The Matchstick Graveyard, death itself becomes uncertain. When Yosun cannot find the body of the man she was told is dead, she refuses to believe in his absence. Convinced that what is lost can still be found, she begins digging into the past with the help of the enigmatic Mr K. Yet the deeper she goes, the clearer it becomes that everything she once heard was a lie, and every lie she believed was incomplete. As reality fractures, Yosun confronts a haunting truth: the reason she struggles to live does not exist in the outside world, but inside her own mind.
